name: Properly source-bound service principal (suite-2 test 27)
note: IAM-1203 / suite-2 test 27: the same SNS topic policy as test 26, but the events.amazonaws.com grant is constrained by ArnEquals aws:SourceArn AND StringEquals aws:SourceAccount (AWS ANDs the two operators). This is the AWS-recommended confused-deputy mitigation, so RESOURCE-CONFUSED-DEPUTY is emitted as a NEGATIVE control (info), with NO missing-source-binding warning. Both SourceArn's account (123456789012) and SourceAccount (123456789012) agree, so it is NOT a mismatch. The analyzer does NOT infer whether the referenced EventBridge rule actually exists.

RESOURCE-CONFUSED-DEPUTY: does NOT infer whether the referenced source resource actually exists
